---
title: About haau3 Research
---

## What it is

haau3 Research publishes open research on caregiving, with and without AI. It is also where we
learn the craft of evaluating AI in public, one small experiment at a time. haau3 Research is part
of [haau3](https://haau3.com).

## What it is not

It is not clinical advice. The work measures how AI answers health questions; it does not answer
them. For a question about your health or someone else's, ask a clinician.

It uses no real person's data. Every patient here is synthetic, generated by
[Synthea](https://synthetichealth.github.io/synthea/).

## Open, and the three things that stay closed

Everything here is open in the open-source sense: anyone may learn from it, reuse it and build on
it, including commercially, and haau3 builds on it too. Three things stay closed, none of them for
money:

1. A benchmark's held-out questions, because publishing them would spoil the measure.
2. Material under someone else's licence, which we link to instead of copying.
3. Anything from a person who has not agreed to share it.

## Who writes and checks the work

Brian K. Fung, a pharmacist, writes and checks every clinical criterion an answer is scored
against. A model may help draft questions, and each note says which model did; a model never
writes or checks a criterion.

## How every note is made

- Each score carries its standard error.
- Comparisons on the same questions are made question by question.
- The code, prompts and run logs are published with the note, and every number on a page is
  computed from the saved run.
- Each note states the model versions, the run dates, what it cost and its limits.
- Every file of benchmark data or results carries a canary string, so it can be kept out of
  training data.

## How to cite

Each note and study gets its own DOI, shown on its page; cite that. To cite the site as a whole,
use the citation file in [its repository](https://github.com/haau3/research).

## Privacy

This site sets no cookies and runs no analytics. GitHub hosts it and keeps its own server logs
under [GitHub's privacy statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

## Contact

Write to [hello@haau3.com](mailto:hello@haau3.com) with a correction, a question or a safety
concern. If a note finds a specific, repeatable way to get dangerous advice from a named product,
we tell its maker before we publish it.
